# Vendored skills

Skills copied verbatim from other repos.
Nothing here is edited locally — a local change would be silently overwritten on the next refresh, and would make the upstream diff meaningless.
To update one, re-copy it from its source and bump the commit below.

- `doc-coauthoring` — from `anthropics/skills`, subdirectory `skills/doc-coauthoring`.
  Taken at `0075614` (2025-12-04); the repo HEAD was `b29e7cf` then.
  Apache 2.0 per the repo README — the repo carries no `LICENSE` file and no per-skill header, so this is the README's blanket claim, not a marked license.
